final.narration: Published river flows are currently running about 41% too low, meaning the river is actually carrying roughly 41% more water than reported, following a shift that began in late July 2025. We are reasonably confident that riverbed scour is the cause, as sediment has washed out and lowered the riverbed. Contact the USGS to request a channel survey and an updated rating curve to correct the published numbers. Trust score 46/100 (Stale).

final.skeptic_argument: The observed residual is +41.1%, which matches scour’s expected positive sign, and the channel geometry is consistent with a lowered control: at the same stage, area rose only 7.7% while velocity rose 1.7%, both within the small/noise range and not enough to argue for fill or a datum change. The debris notes point the other way on sign (negative residuals), so they do not overturn the scour case.
